user.description: Connect your Bosch eBike with ConnectModule to Home Assistant. You will be redirected to Bosch to authenticate.

auth.title: Authenticate with Bosch
auth.description:
⚠️ **Use a desktop or laptop browser.** On a phone the Flow app opens instead and you won't see the code.

**Step 1:** Copy this URL into a **new browser tab** (a private/incognito window works best):

`{auth_url}`

**Step 2:** Log in with your Bosch eBike Flow account.

**Step 3:** The page then fails to redirect - this is expected. Press **F12** to open the developer tools and find the address starting with `onebikeapp-ios://`:

- **Chrome / Edge:** open the **Network** tab, click the `oauth2redirect` request and copy the **Request URL**
- **Firefox:** open the **Console** tab - the message *Prevented navigation to "onebikeapp-ios://..."* contains it
- **Chromium on Linux:** it is also shown in the *xdg-open* prompt or the error that follows it

**Step 4:** Paste the **whole URL** below (just the part after `code=` works too). Be quick - the code expires after about a minute.

Stuck? See the [step-by-step guide]({guide_url}).
